audit.line.texts.refused: {when}: the checker refused a text the assistant wrote.
audit.line.texts.rewrite_asked: {when}: {who} asked for {count} texts of {name} to be written again.
audit.line.texts.version_rewrite_asked: {when}: {who} asked for {count} texts in {language} to be written again.
audit.line.texts.restored: {when}: {who} brought back the earlier version of {count} texts of {name}.
audit.line.texts.language_changed: {when}: {who} had the pages of {name} written in {language}.
audit.line.texts.note_changed: {when}: {who} changed the note the assistant keeps on how to write to {name}.
audit.line.writing.choices_changed: {when}: {who} changed what the assistant writes at once and whether he speaks first.
audit.line.voice.phrase_weakness_told: {when}: {who} was told that a phrase said aloud can be heard by whoever is in the room.
audit.line.voice.stranger_paused: {when}: {who} stopped answering a voice nobody knew at the microphone {name} for {count} minutes.
audit.line.voice.stranger_word_dropped: {when}: {who} gave up leaving a word about a voice nobody knew, held back by a rule for a day.
audit.outcome.not_yours: it was not theirs to answer
audit.outcome.needs_proof: it needs a proof that it is them
audit.outcome.approver_changed: it now waits for someone else's yes
audit.outcome.paused: it waits for someone to arrive
audit.outcome.arrived: it waits for a yes again
audit.outcome.writer_asks: the writer of rights has a question
audit.verdict.warn: warn, then ask for a yes
audit.verdict.proof: ask for a yes with a proof
security.origin_refused: This request was refused because it did not come from this site, but from another site.
voice.on_gesture: I hear you while you hold the button
voice.no_attention: I hear well, but the voice cannot stay on yet: nothing at home can quickly tell when someone is talking to me. I explain your two choices in our conversation
voice.no_attention_asked: I hear well, but the voice cannot stay on yet: nothing at home can quickly tell when someone is talking to me. Only the owner chooses how I should listen, and I am asking them
voice.refused_by_browser: The browser did not allow the microphone
voice.moved: The voice moved to another tab or device
voice.reload: Reload this page to use the voice
voice.not_taken_elsewhere: What you just said was heard on another page, so it is not taken here
voice.not_taken_now: I did not take what was just said
voice.failed: What you just said could not be answered
voice.not_told: What you just said could not be passed on to the assistant
voice.cannot_speak: The answer cannot be said aloud right now; it is written on the page
voice.cannot_speak_preparing: The assistant's voice is still getting ready, so the answer is written on the page
voice.cannot_speak_limit: The assistant's voice has reached its spending limit, so the answer is written on the page
voice.cannot_speak_no_model: The assistant has no voice to speak with yet, so the answer is written on the page
voice.cannot_play: This page cannot play the assistant's voice right now; the answer is written on the page
voice.prints_erased_word: I erased what I had learnt of your voice; I will learn it again as you speak with me
voice.phrase_removed_word: Your spoken phrase was removed at someone else's request; agree a new one with me when you wish
talk.no_key: The assistant cannot answer yet: he has no key to think with.
talk.too_long: That is too long to send.
talk.not_sayable: The assistant cannot take that message.
talk.held_back: Too many tries. Wait a little, then try again.
talk.proof.nothing_waits: Nothing waits for a proof here.
talk.proof.busy: The assistant is checking too many passwords at once. Try again in a moment.
talk.unknown_command: The assistant does not know that command here. Type /quit to leave.
talk.unreachable: The assistant cannot be reached at {url}.
talk.not_trusted: His certificate is not trusted by this computer.
talk.unpaired_now: The assistant does not know this computer any more. Press Enter to leave.
